Dimension Portals & Item Combos

Collect the special item combos to travel between dimensions and fight every Boss!

🏫 1. Overworld: Woodman Park School (Dover, NH)

Features the stepped red-brick Woodman Park Elementary building, roof spire, wood-chip playground, pine trees, and the Brick Golem Boss on the roof!

🌲 2. The Nether: The Deep Forest

Drawn on the right of the sketch! Enter the swirling 6-circle Forest Portal across the wooden slat bridge and defeat the Nether Forest Treant Boss!

Combo Needed: Pickaxe ⛏️ + Shield 🛡️ (or walk into the Portal on the right!)
🚀 3. The End: Outer Space (Boss: MY MOM!)

Drawn on the left of the sketch! Low-gravity space arena with the healing Space Crystal pillar and My Mom (The Ender Dragon) breathing a giant laser beam at your shield!

Combo Needed: Special Laser Eyes 👀⚡ + Shield 🛡️ +Pickaxe ⛏️

Original Game Design Blueprint & How It Works

🐉 Left Panel: "end/space"

"ender dragon / my mom" shoots a giant diagonal beam down at the stick-figure hero holding up a square Shield! The pillar on the right holds the spinning Healing Crystal beaming energy to her head.

🏫 Center: "Over/world/ woodman park"

Based on Woodman Park School in Dover, NH! The stepped building has a tall spire, the blocky striped Boss on the roof, a minion on the left, the stick hero with the giant spiky sword, and the "inventory" hotbar below.

🌲 Right Panel: "nether/forest"

"make the nether the forest" — features the wooden slat bridge, the waving stick figure, and the tall forest portal filled with 6 swirling vortex circles!

🎮 How to Play Mine World

🏃 Move & Jump: Press A / D or Arrow Keys, and W / Space to jump.

✋ Work to Get Items: Start with Bare Hands (Slot 1) and click on any Pine Tree at Woodman Park to punch wood! Collect 3 Wood Logs and press C to craft a Crafting Table.

⛏️ Pickaxe & Building: Craft a Pickaxe to break hard blocks (Red School Bricks, Stone, Playground Wood-Chips, Space Crystal Pillars). Select any Block in slots 6–8 and click empty air to build!

👀⚡ Shoot Lasers: Press E (or select Laser Eyes in Slot 4 and click anywhere) to shoot eye lasers that damage bosses and blocks!

🛡️ Block Mom's Dragon Beam: Hold Q or Shift (or equip your Shield in Slot 5) to block and reflect boss attacks—especially My Mom's Giant Dragon Beam in Space!
